title: Private jet charter to and from Marrakech
description: Private flights to and from Marrakech: Ménara's runway, round-the-clock customs, overnight authorisation and handling rule, from the Moroccan AIP.
h1: Private flights to and from Marrakech
lead: Marrakech Ménara has customs around the clock. What a private flight needs, from the Moroccan AIP.

p: Ménara has {{gmmx.runway}} and {{gmmx.customs}}. There is {{gmmx.handling}}, and an aircraft staying overnight needs {{gmmx.ppr}}.

Every person travelling needs a valid passport and any visa the country asks for. The operator and its handling agent arrange customs, immigration and ground handling for your arrival and departure, and tell you where to meet the crew.

Your trip brief names the airport, where private flights are handled and the contact on the ground. Your broker stays with you from the first enquiry to the last landing, and follows up after the trip.

sections.h: How we plan a private flight to or from Marrakech
p: Tell us where you are flying from or to, when, and how many people are travelling. We compare the airports around Marrakech for your times and your aircraft, find aircraft from licensed operators, check each operator before you see a quote, and name the operator in your quote and agreement. Any aircraft, any route, upon availability.

Airport rules change at short notice. The operator and its handling agent confirm the current rules for your flight before departure; every fact on this page shows its source and the date we checked it.

faq.q: Does Archē Executive operate the flight?
faq.a: No. We are a broker. A licensed operator flies every trip, and it is named in your quote and charter agreement before you confirm.
